subject: Transportation Systems
title: Who Will Afford Flying Taxis?
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Who Will Afford Flying Taxis?.

hook.text: Early eVTOL rides will cost roughly what a helicopter charter costs today—hundreds of dollars per trip.

buildup.text: As production scales, companies project costs dropping to $3 to $5 per mile—comparable to ride-hailing.

discovery.text: At scale, electric motors and low maintenance costs could make air taxis genuinely affordable.

twist.text: Battery replacement, insurance, and pilot costs eat into those projections. The math is optimistic.

climax.text: If prices don't drop, air taxis become a luxury for the wealthy—not a mass transit solution.

punchline.text: Affordable air taxis: possible in theory, unproven in practice.

quiz.question: What do eVTOL companies project their per-mile cost could reach at scale?
